harrow.name: Harrow
harrow.description: Achieve redemption through vengeance. The monastic Harrow increases damage to support allies. Defy enemies and ascend.

abilities.name: Condemn
abilities.description: Cast a wave of energy that chains them where they stand. Each enemy held reinforces Harrow's shields.

abilities.name: Penance
abilities.description: Sacrifice Shields to boost Reload Speed, and Fire Rate while converting damage inflicted on enemies into health for Harrow and nearby allies.

abilities.name: Thurible
abilities.description: Channel Harrow's energy into the Thurible to generate a buff. Once finished, kill enemies to bestow nearby allies with bursts of energy. The more energy channeled the greater the reward for each kill. Weak Point kills produce extra energy.

abilities.name: Covenant
abilities.description: Protect nearby allies with an energy force that absorbs all damage and converts it to a Critical Chance bonus for all those under the Covenant. Weak Point hits are amplified even further.

harrow-prime.name: Harrow Prime
harrow-prime.description: The Inquisitor Eternal arises, hallowed by the Void, preaching a gospel of iron and flame.

abilities.name: Energized Munitions
abilities.description: Increase the efficiency of your ammo consumption.

abilities.name: Master's Summons
abilities.description: Heal your companion and call it to your side.

abilities.name: Voracious Metastasis
abilities.description: Consume Energy to heal yourself and grant matching Energy to each ally.

abilities.name: Perspicacity
abilities.description: Automatically succeed at your next hack attempt.

abilities.name: Sickening Pulse
abilities.description: Emit a pulse that adds stacks to Status Effects already afflicting enemies. The damage of <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash, <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat, and <DT_POISON_COLOR>Toxin effects, excluding those created by Sickening Pulse itself, are added together to create a new instance of the Effect with a refreshed timer

abilities.name: Hideous Resistance
abilities.description: Grant yourself immunity to Status effects.

abilities.name: Parasitic Armor
abilities.description: Sacrifice Shields to reinforce Armor for a period of time.

abilities.name: Rebuild Shields
abilities.description: Instantly restore your shields.

abilities.name: Infested Mobility
abilities.description: Increase your parkour velocity.

abilities.name: Expedite Suffering
abilities.description: Condense all <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash and <DT_POISON_COLOR>Toxin Status Effects into a single damage instance.

abilities.name: Empower
abilities.description: Increase the strength of your next ability use.

abilities.name: Marked For Death
abilities.description: Stun an enemy; a portion of the next damage you deal to it will be dealt to all enemies around it.

abilities.name: Golden Instinct
abilities.description: Send out a short-lived Void Spark that is drawn toward the nearest Medallion, Ayatan Sculpture, rare crate, unscanned Kuria or unscanned Fragment.

hildryn.name: Hildryn
hildryn.description: Strength is Hildryn's virtue. Her unique high-damage abilities are powered by her Shields, which can be recharged with Energy. Hildryn proves that a strong offense is a good defense.

abilities.name: Balefire
abilities.description: Charge and launch devastating bolts of electricity.

abilities.name: Pillage
abilities.description: Pillage a percentage of Shields and Armor of nearby enemies to replenish Hildryn's own Shields and Overshields. Also removes Status Effects from Hildryn and her allies.

abilities.name: Haven
abilities.description: Create a shield aura around allies. Enemies that approach Hildryn will take <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>Radiation Damage.

abilities.name: Aegis Storm
abilities.description: Take the skies and rain Balefire rockets down on the enemy. Nearby enemies are blasted into the air where they will create an Energy Orb every few seconds. When shields run out the enemies are smashed into the ground.

hildryn-prime.name: Hildryn Prime
hildryn-prime.description: Hildryn Prime proves that power is discipline’s reward.

hydroid.name: Hydroid
hydroid.description: Hydroid summons the power of the ocean depths. He provides crowd control with aqueous attacks. His enemies will meet a watery demise.

abilities.name: Tempest Barrage
abilities.description: Summon a tempest to rain down upon a target area.

abilities.name: Tidal Surge
abilities.description: Crash through enemies in a ferocious wall of water.

abilities.name: Plunder
abilities.description: Plunder Armor from nearby enemies and increase <DT_CORROSIVE_COLOR>Corrosive Damage on your Abilities and weapons. Enemies affected by <DT_CORROSIVE_COLOR>Corrosive Status offer a greater increase.

abilities.name: Tentacle Swarm
abilities.description: Summon a creature from the depths. Its watery tentacles emerge from nearby surfaces to wreak havoc.

hydroid-prime.name: Hydroid Prime
hydroid-prime.description: Command the ocean's fury with this king of gold and silver. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.
